title: Farmers Market Vendor Inspection Log
subtitle: Farmers Market Vendor Operation: records repeated checks and excursions.
description: Farmers Market Vendor Inspection Log covers vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout. The market vendor coordinator records Farmers Market Vendor Operation check times, results, excursions, and review. Farmers Market Vendor Inspection Log keeps Farmers Market Vendor Operation exceptions visible until the market vendor coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Farmers Market Vendor Inspection Log at market, booth, vehicle, storage cooler, display, and customer service area. Document vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout identity before Farmers Market Vendor Operation begins. Compare vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout findings with stated Farmers Market Vendor Operation criteria; route unresolved Farmers Market Vendor Operation issues to market operations or food-safety reviewer. For Farmers Market Vendor Inspection Log, confirm requirements for Farmers Market Vendor Operation. Ask market operations or food-safety reviewer to review Farmers Market Vendor Operation conditions beyond the market vendor coordinator's role.

sections.title: Recorder, location, and log identity
sections.guidance: For Farmers Market Vendor Operation, identify responsible parties, market, booth, vehicle, storage cooler, display, and customer service area, and the linked vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout source.

fields.label: Product, lot, source, quantity, and price
Permit, insurance, contact, and payment identifiers

sections.title: Log exception entries and corrections
sections.guidance: Capture Farmers Market Vendor Operation facts for vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Farmers Market Vendor Operation monitored controls
items: Label, price, allergen, and customer information
Cash, electronic payment, and sales reconciliation
Unsold product, waste, complaint, and incident closeout

columns.label: Vendor, booth, product, or sales interval
Correct, hold, refund, escalate, or none

sections.title: Period outcome and next monitoring point
sections.guidance: Resolve open Farmers Market Vendor Operation log excursions; have market vendor coordinator record the period result, review owner, and next monitoring point.

blocks.label: Excursions, missed checks, and retained evidence
items: Complaint or unsold product lacks disposition
blocks.guidance: Pause Farmers Market Vendor Operation when vendor authority, product trace, display control, complaint, or product disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Farmers Market Vendor Operation proof and route unresolved vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout scope to market vendor coordinator.
